records.source: Where a finished run's measurements are also stored. sqlite keeps only measurements.db. duckdb copies every table into a DuckDB file and parquet into a folder of Parquet files, both for very large screens; postgres copies them into a PostgreSQL database that several users can write at once. spacr_store writes each object table and its crops as the spaCR store in the measurements folder, one Parquet part and one Zarr crop store per well, which spacr.store.open reads. measurements.db stays the working copy every later step reads. Needs pip install spacr[databases]. Default sqlite.
records.translation: Hvar mælingar lokinnar keyrslu eru einnig geymdar. sqlite heldur aðeins measurements.db. duckdb afritar hverja töflu í DuckDB-skrá og parquet í möppu með Parquet-skrám, hvort tveggja fyrir mjög stórar skimanir; postgres afritar þær í PostgreSQL-gagnagrunn sem margir notendur geta skrifað í samtímis. spacr_store skrifar hverja hlutatöflu og úrklippur hennar sem spaCR-geymslu í möppuna measurements, einn Parquet-hluta og eina Zarr-úrklippugeymslu fyrir hverja holu, sem spacr.store.open les. measurements.db er áfram vinnueintakið sem öll síðari skref lesa. Krefst pip install spacr[databases]. Sjálfgefið: sqlite.
